# Go-to-Market

**Private short price calls, firm quotes, and inspectable Canton/Daml settlement rules for active traders.**

## First distribution

| Channel | Planned first action |
| --- | --- |
| **@owarine_app** | Share the walkthrough and invite people to complete a demo trade. |
| **Canton community** | Run hands-on demos and collect feedback on privacy, trust, and execution. |
| **Direct trader trials** | Watch first-use sessions and improve the parts that cause confusion. |

## Acquisition hypotheses

| Hypothesis to test | Measure |
| --- | --- |
| A clear firm quote helps testers complete their first trade. | First-trade completion. |
| Private positions and visible outcome evidence give traders a reason to return. | Repeat use and interview feedback. |
| Easier mobile onboarding makes the core flow more accessible. | Completion in mobile user tests. |

## Build after the hackathon

| Milestone | Status |
| --- | --- |
| **Canton DevNet web prototype** | Available with demo credits and test funds. |
| **Native mobile app** | In development. |
| **TestNet launch** | Planned after user testing and improvements to wallet access and reliability. |

Transaction fees are a business-model hypothesis to validate with users. Pricing and paying-customer results have not yet been established.

**We are building beyond the hackathon: demo, learn, improve, and bring Owarine to more users.**
